# The travelling jigsaw

<a id="jigsaw-box-lid"></a>
## #0 — The picture arrives before the pieces

The puzzle begins with its destination already visible. A picture on the box shows what the pieces will become. The maker sets out the edges, builds the frame and sorts the remaining pieces by the marks which promise a place within it. Each successful fit confirms a small part of the anticipated whole. The work is exact, patient and productive: a local fragment acquires a legible relation to its neighbours.

Yet the finished picture has entered the work before the first piece is placed. It supplies the criterion by which every later placement will be judged. The maker can hesitate over a patch of colour while remaining entirely certain what counts as completion. The lid decides which differences belong together, which edge is outside and which apparent anomaly is merely a piece still awaiting its correct position.

Frank Taylor’s travelling image begins from this arrangement. It is an authored image of inquiry, not an account of a particular historical puzzle or an ancient myth. Its [governing development] **grounds** the passage from a pre-given box-lid to an atlas, while the [quilt’s correction of the travelling image](../../../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md) **sources** the requirement that the same puzzle be reconstructed. Its first task is diagnostic. The world is approached as though all of its possible appearances had already been cut into pieces by a maker whose picture requires only assembly.

[Heidegger’s world-picture passages](../../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/heidegger/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology.md#heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology-q012) **historicise** the relevant diagnosis: world grasped as picture and the representer installed as its normative centre belong to one event in his account. The puzzle gives Taylor’s continuation a material form. Its lid can remain absent from discussion precisely because everything discussed has already been assigned a possible place beneath it.

<a id="jigsaw-travel-and-reconstruction"></a>
## #1 — Travel changes what it means to fit

The puzzle travels into the world it claims to depict. Its maker encounters a turn which the flat arrangement cannot preserve, a continuation beyond an edge, a view whose apparent distortion changes with position. The image’s pressure is no longer simply to find one more piece. The question reaches the frame and the prior picture: what relation was lost when this domain was rendered in this way?

At first the completed assembly can absorb the difficulty as an imperfection in the traveller’s knowledge. Another piece will arrive, another detail will be filled. But an additional piece is still being judged under the same criterion. The change comes when the maker begins to record how a view was made: from where, across which region, under what projection, with which omissions and with what possibility of passing to another view.

The pieces now acquire a different office. They become local charts. Their edges mark limits of usable description; neighbouring charts can overlap rather than merely meet along a cut. Within an overlap, the maker must be able to explain how a position described here appears there. A difference between two reports can then disclose a change of coordinates, a difference in what is being measured, or a disagreement which the available translation does not resolve. The seam becomes an operative relation.

The box-lid loses its power to predetermine every fit, but picturing continues. A local view can become more accurate as its limits become better known. The regulating whole is carried by the domain, its coverage and the rules of transition. An atlas can be worked through: one enters a chart, crosses through an overlap, learns what changed and returns with the route available. Its unity is realised through these crossings rather than installed as an image which every piece must reproduce.

The traveller eventually returns to a familiar place. In the first puzzle, arrival would have meant another confirmation of the lid. In the reconstructed puzzle, arrival also brings the history of the passage. The same local address can have been reached by a different route; the account can retain what the route taught. The next departure begins with an altered relation to the map.

This is the whole travelling action: given picture, exact local assembly, encounter with its limits, disclosure of the framing activity, reconstruction as traversable local accounts and return with difference retained. [A22, World-Picture → World-Atlas](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **grounds** its constructive force. [C37, World-Atlas](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **defines** its repeatable demand. The first picture remains available as a situated achievement within the atlas it could not originally admit.

<a id="jigsaw-mathematical-witness"></a>
## #2 — A crossing has a rule, and a return retains a path

The mathematical witness is Offered for the reconstructive proposal; the constructions themselves retain the Derived standing of their Matheme homes. [The manifold-atlas Matheme](../../../../matheme/topology/manifold-atlas.md) **derives** charts and their transitions on specified domains. It does not infer a smooth atlas from the mere existence of several opinions.

Its circle example makes the distinction tangible. Two charts cover the circle by omitting opposite poles. At the point `(x,y)=(3/5,4/5)`, their coordinates are `u=3` and `v=1/3`. On their overlap the rule is `v=1/u`. The reports differ numerically because they use different coordinates; the declared transformation identifies their common point. Height is `4/5` in either account. Even motion must be transformed: when `du/dt=2` at this point, `dv/dt=−2/9`, and both descriptions give the same change of height. Giving both coordinate velocities the number two would change the motion being described.

This exactness is the positive achievement of the atlas. Its local pictures can disagree in their written values while agreeing in what those values describe. The overlap and transformation explain the agreement. Conversely, when the inverse is missing, the common domain is absent or the required regularity fails, the same conclusion does not follow. [C52, Dimensional Reframing](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C52-Dimensional-Reframing-at-Zero-and-Infinity.md) **qualifies** the change: name which space and operation have changed. [A03, Immutable Gap](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) receives the distinct native consequence that representing a condition produces another determination; a coordinate singularity is not by itself the proof of that argument.

The compact circle, sphere and torus cannot each be covered by one global chart into an open Euclidean coordinate domain of the same dimension. Compactness gives the obstruction. A drawing of the whole surface is still possible; what fails is its being that single global chart. The topological distinction also sharpens the first puzzle. Under its disk abstraction, every loop is contractible. This does not forbid walking back to a starting point. What it lacks is the torus’s independent, non-contractible winding classes. The diagnosis concerns the loss of that relation, not a ban on ordinary movement across a flat picture.

[The torus-cover Matheme](../../../../matheme/topology/torus-cover-winding.md) **derives** the next operation:

`T² = R²/Z²`, with `(x,y) ~ (x+m,y+n)` for integers `(m,n)`.

One surface address has infinitely many representatives on the plane. A small neighbourhood is accurately represented by a local lift; the quotient tells how its other representatives are related. Now follow the loop `[2t,−t]`, from `t=0` to `t=1`. It returns to `[0,0]` on the torus while its lift moves from `(0,0)` to `(2,−1)`. The pair records winding. It does not record the traveller’s entire experience or the timing of every step. [A17, Toroidal Circulation](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A17-Toroidal-Circulation-and-the-Arche-Topos.md) **grounds** the authorial use of local closure with retained displacement; [A16, Arche-Topos](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field.md) **grounds** the field of possible placements and paths.

The finite presentation thus keeps its relation to the infinite cover. The four sides of the presenting square and the two independent generating loops have distinct structural offices; the quotient’s Euler count uses one vertex, two edge classes and one face. These counts cannot be exchanged merely because a picture makes them look alike. Nor is the familiar embedded doughnut the flat quotient’s intrinsic metric. Exact differences make the image capable of carrying more than an attractive shape.

<a id="jigsaw-native-and-archetypal-field"></a>
## #3 — The frame enters the account it makes possible

The [native core source](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) **grounds** the author’s full field; the [Definition of God, Draft 3](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md) **sources** the formal-limit, relation and return in their authored register. [A18](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) carries the eight determinations, `−/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`, under `/ = −/−`. The puzzle traverses this field through a change in the relation to its own determinations.

The frame first makes a particular fit possible. Under `−/−`, its determining relation cannot be exhausted by one more item fitted within it. `0/1` gives source-through-expression: the local picture is real while the conditions of its appearance remain active. `?/!` becomes concrete when an encountered mismatch can question the rule of fit and elicit an answer which changes the inquiry. At `−/+`, a definite contrast remains necessary; the atlas must distinguish valid and invalid transitions. Reopening the frame does not abolish judgment.

`X/x` carries the particular representation without letting it exhaust the relation it expresses. A coordinate, local chart or pictured person remains determinate; the account of participation is authorial QL, not notation borrowed from a historical theory of maps. `AM/IS` brings the maker and the addressed participant back into the scene. The account has someone to answer to, including a You whose response cannot be supplied in advance by the lid. `∞/dx` gives the local exactness its non-exhaustive horizon. The torus lift is one mathematically specified witness within that larger field, not an identity between all infinities, all derivatives and all journeys.

At `1/0`, the achieved picture returns through its conditions. It can disclose its source, revise a relation and enter another encounter. The native parents `(0/1)/(1/0)` and `(1/0)/(0/1)` keep the complete body in inverse orientations. The six positions of this page articulate the puzzle’s particular movement; they neither replace the eight determinations nor manufacture them from six narrative scenes. Definition/Quilt and Process/Music retain their distinct return chains in the native supporting texts.

[C08, Context Frame](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) **defines** the local holding that lets this work proceed. A frame selects sources, rules and possibilities; it is itself an operation within a world. [A26, Objective Internality](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **grounds** the deeper distinction between conditions of worldhood and the representations produced within them. A larger inventory of contextual facts still does not stand outside every condition of its production.

The shared [Neumann archetypal structuration](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation) **qualifies** this travelling image through the author’s articulation of genesis, separation, opposition and return. Differentiation makes a position and its opposed field available; the heroic achievement of a standpoint can subsequently be mistaken for possession of the whole. The [centroversion return](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-hero-centroversion) keeps that achievement within the more comprehensive relation from which it emerged. The [Neumann source house and protected encounter](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness.md) **sources** this comparative ground with its own historical and authorial distinctions. Taylor’s primordial-recognition correction survives: the condition of appearing is not created by the later ego’s successful assembly of an identity.

This common archetypal field does not assign every culture the same cartographic history. The present whole has its home in Taylor’s authored world; Gebser’s historical account, Heidegger’s diagnosis and Bratton’s contemporary programme retain their different dates and sources. Geography answers where an account is situated. Time answers when it is made, transmitted and changed. The traveller needs both, and neither can replace the other.

<a id="jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge"></a>
## #4 — The planet appears, and the making of the picture returns

The Blue Marble enters at the programme’s hinge between a final box-lid world-picture and a first diaphanous planetary image. Here it is the authored image-unit named in the quilt, not a newly selected NASA photograph. A bounded view of Earth can gather attention around a shared planet. The question is what happens to the position, instrument, production and measure through which that view becomes available.

As a box-lid, the planetary picture settles in advance what the world is and what its pieces must mean. “Planetary” can then become the unexamined scale under which particular lives, places and claims are counted. The quilt’s questions reopen that apparent completeness: whose planet, computed by whom, on whose gauge? They require a situated answer. An image’s breadth of view cannot by itself establish the authority of the account made through it.

The same image can become diaphanous when its conditions remain readable within its use. The view acquires a location and a time; its production and transformations become inspectable; what lies outside its selected account can matter to the next judgment. The image continues to disclose Earth. What changes is the viewer’s relation to the picture’s power. No particular NASA frame, date, mission, credit, processing history or reproduction right has been selected for this whole, so none is supplied by inference from the familiar name. Those are concrete acquisition duties before an asset can be attached.

[Gebser’s source house](../../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md) **historicises** aperspectivity as liberation from the exclusive validity of perspective, rather than the mere synthesis of views. The opening pages of the selected English work preserve the powers of perspectival articulation within the question of integrality. The essay extends that method into technically active context. [A04, Diaphaneity](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) with [C09](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) **grounds** the change: a disclosure makes its situated viewer legible along with its world. Taylor’s direct Gebser development adds care for the outcome—being with the text and subtext. Context is consequential participation, not aloofness furnished with a longer caption.

[A20, Image / Valuation / Possession](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) **tests** whether the image can still be changed by what it claims to disclose. [C38, Bimba–Pratibimba](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) and [C61, Disclosure Architecture](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture.md) **qualify** the reconstructed atlas itself. A produced world-picture is pratibimba. Within a declared Context Frame it can genuinely occupy Bimba, the local original for situated readings which are its pratibimbas. It remains pratibimba relative to wider sources, and returned evidence can revise that local original itself. The corrected optical relation likewise keeps QL as the ordered spectrum and MEF as the apparatus of refraction; neither makes the cast image its own originating light.

The [Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account whole field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **extends** this hinge through all four operational relations at register 3. Encounter-in-Region places the planetary claim before it becomes a universal report. Name-through-Count asks which distinctions and exclusions make its units reckonable. Count-through-Countenance lets an addressed participant answer the scale under which they were counted. Count-to-Account makes the criterion, provenance and consequence available to scrutiny. [A27](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) receives the irreducible reply; [A30](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) receives the shared conditions that reply can change. The planetary Account **returns-to** the whole field as another situated encounter. No shared lexical descent is claimed for its six terms.

<a id="jigsaw-atlas-return"></a>
## #5→0 — The atlas travels with the means to revise it

The reconstructive technical proposal begins where the first puzzle had finished. Its map-making operation travels alongside its map. [C39, MEF](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework.md) **defines** the lenses and gauges through which an inquiry changes salience, evidence and judgment. The corrected twelve-lens field retains the whole rotated Name/Power constellation on both faces. A change of lens must change what the inquiry does; twelve labels on the same unaltered picture do not perform twelve readings.

The quilt offers Mapper as a concrete research route: choose a filter or lens, cover its range, pull the cover back, cluster locally and construct the nerve. Retaining the lens, cover and clustering choices makes the resulting representation answerable to its construction. A Mapper nerve is not automatically a manifold atlas, and its overlaps do not alone supply invertible coordinate transitions. Sheaf methods offer another route through local data, restriction maps and compatibility. Under specified gluing conditions, a genuine obstruction remains a result to expose. It neither proves that no computation is possible nor mathematically entails an ethical pledge. The authored surety comparison names a further responsibility at the point where the current formal arrangement cannot supply the required continuation. These proposed implementations remain Offered; no experiment is reported here.

The [Homologia / Analogia whole field](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** all of these crossings. Homological agreement specifies the preserved operation—local determination with recoverable conditions and return. Analogical proportion states the respect in which the mathematical and epistemic objects answer to one another. Its research boundary keeps common appearance, common cause and historical descent separate. The achieved relation **returns-to** that field with the atlas/Mapper/sheaf distinctions intact. [A34, Idealism](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) receives the direction of dependence precisely: Subject/Consciousness → Mind/Objective Internality → Object remains the essay’s positive ontological argument. A useful coordinate system does not prove that order; its independence from that proof does not reduce the argument to mere uncertainty about representations.

[Bratton’s Agentworld source](../../../../episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q029) **tests** the proposal against a contemporary problem: sufficiently divergent world-models need a common procedural grammar through which disagreement becomes legible. The atlas accepts that pressure and offers explicit transitions, scope and obstruction as part of its response. The brief’s scenarios do not endorse this particular architecture or establish its success. Its representation mandate and harness discussion keep the work constructive: develop means by which participants can inspect how a view acquired force and how their actions alter later conditions.

[A31, Deferential Intelligence](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **tests** whether the encountered world can revise the interpreting model. [A32, The Mirror That Moves First](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md), with [C55](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md), **extends** the obligation to the instrument’s own initiative: expose the conditions which made this picture compelling before asking another to conform. [A33, Operational Parity](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity.md) asks what actually changes—a judgment, a selected source, a permission, a criterion, a relation between local reference fields. The atlas earns its practical return when those changes reach the next act.

The whole **returns-to** [M05, Gebser / Diaphaneity](../../../../../section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/05-s01-p4-gebser-diaphaneity.md), with the box-lid diagnosis and the promise of reconstructive picturing; [M30, Arche-Topos](../../../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/30-s3-p5-arche-topos.md), with exact cover, chart and traversal offices; and [M41, Bimba and Energy Fields](../../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/41-s5-p4-bimba-energy-fields.md), with a made-and-avowed reference picture. It **returns-to** [M42, Research Vectors](../../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/42-s5-p5-research-vectors.md) and [M44, the Proposed Harness](../../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md), with the tests and implementation duties still to be performed.

The traveller opens the first picture again. Its colours and local fits have not lost their achievement. They can now be read with their frame, their missed continuations and the routes into other accounts. The atlas is carried forward as an instrument within the world: sufficiently definite to guide the next step, sufficiently answerable for the journey to change where it leads.

**Amplification and source standing.** `human-amplified: yes` applies to the declared travelling-jigsaw reconstruction, Blue Marble hinge, native and Neumann structuration, corrected Bimba relation and programme returns. `human-amplified: no` applies to the newly written illustrative traveller actions and explanatory phrasing; they are not reported events or newly ratified symbolic identities. Mathematical constructions retain their own Derived warrants, the travelling relation is Argued, and the technical witness/application remains Offered. Heidegger print collation and flagged locators, Gebser quotation readiness, exact mathematical-source passage collation, and NASA frame selection remain independent source duties. No image asset or implementation result is asserted.
